_comment: The Aqara S1 Plus's budgets (#68). Project choices, not published standards; docs/perf.md, "RAM", and docs/size.md say why and how each is measured. Clarity's report (tools/perf/report.py) reads ram and panes.*.ram_pss_max_kb; CI's size check (tools/size/apksize.py) reads size and panes.*.size_max_bytes, and fails a PR that goes over unless the same PR raises the budget. The pane RAM budgets were set before the first per-pane measurement (2026-11-13); revisit them once one exists. The size budgets are the 2026-11-13 release build (97.84 MB armeabi-v7a, 100.78 MB arm64-v8a) plus about 2.5%, and each pane's size about twice its own today (at least 100 kB), so growth is a decision, not a drift.

radio.note: its processes run outside the app and are measured in place

timers.note: comes only with the voice assistant, so it is inside assist's share
